name: ap-monorepo
description: Apa penguin kiosk for cggalleries.com — root scripts for /kiosk and the Cloudflare Pages Functions in /functions

scripts.dev: node scripts/build-pages-config.mjs && concurrently -n api,kiosk -c blue,magenta "npx wrangler pages dev kiosk/dist --port 8787 --ip 127.0.0.1" "npm:dev --prefix kiosk"
scripts.build:pages: npm run build --prefix kiosk && node scripts/build-pages-config.mjs
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build --prefix kiosk && npx wrangler pages deploy kiosk/dist --project-name apa-v1 --branch main --commit-dirty=true
